newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber stable, Singapore buys.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber stable, Singapore buys.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 prices were generally stable in late trading on Wednesday as the market remained lethargic despite a Singapore deal.
Dealers said Singapore dealers bought SIR20 at 55.25 cents/lb fob Palembang, but the quantity was not known.
"There were no other trades or fresh enquiries," one dealer said. "Buyers are generally well below offer prices."

Dealers said SIR20 was on offer in Medan at 55.50 cents/lb, 55.25 cents in Surabaya and 55.00 cents in Padang, Jambi and Pontianak. They said the latex market was quiet, which was last done at 2,230 rupiah/kg.
